statistics.pending: Analyzing {{count}} hand(s): figures update by themselves.
statistics.smallSample: Fewer than 1,000 hands: rates still move a lot from one session to the next.
statistics.definitions: Each rate counts only the hands where the situation happened (hover a figure for the count). Definitions follow the usual tracker conventions.

stats.vpipHint: Put money in the pot voluntarily preflop
stats.stealHint: Opened from the cutoff, button or small blind when folded to
stats.rfiHint: First in with a raise when folded to
stats.limpHint: First in with a call when folded to
stats.foldToThreeBetHint: Folded after opening and facing a re-raise
stats.cbetFlopHint: Bet the flop as the preflop raiser when checked to
stats.wentToShowdownHint: Reached showdown after seeing the flop

import.title: Import
import.description: Add your Winamax hand histories and tournament summaries.

drop.title: Drop your Winamax files here
drop.hint: Hand histories and tournament summaries (.txt), or a .zip archive. You can drop a whole folder: importing the same file twice never creates duplicates.
drop.where: On a Mac, Winamax saves them in ~/Library/Application Support/winamax/documents/accounts/<your pseudonym>/history. In the file picker, press ⌘⇧G and paste this path (the Library folder is hidden by default).
drop.nothing: No .txt or .zip file in this selection.

import.ignored: {{count}} file(s) left out: only .txt and .zip files are imported.

errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Too much data at once. Import fewer files at a time.
errors.TOO_MANY_FILES: Too many files at once. Import fewer files at a time.
errors.INVALID_ENCODING: Unexpected text encoding: this is not an original Winamax file.
errors.UNRECOGNIZED_FORMAT: Not a Winamax hand history or tournament summary.
errors.NO_VALID_HAND: No complete hand could be read in this file.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: This file could not be processed. It will be retried if you import it again.
errors.network: Poker Coach cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
